zhaozhou2024pigeonhole: immediate cellwise treatment balancing supplies a close grid/parity construction, but not stored-unmatched hard-cap matching with pathwise terminal emptying.

ascheretal2026generalarrivals and morrison2025reservoir respectively cover uncapped forced completion and a nonempty packing reservoir; neither establishes fixed-branching, deterministic-cap endpoint clearance.

No verified cited result gives matching all-policy lower and attaining upper orders for additive prognostic-score regret under deterministic capacity, arrival-incidence pairing, and a common forced-completion deadline.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The publication states that, among stratified randomization schemes treating each unit with probability one half, a matched-pair design attains maximum precision for the ATE; the exact full-text theorem was access-restricted.

Theorem 1 gives a CLT conditional on a sub-root reservoir remainder and shrinking intrapair distances; Theorem 2 verifies those conditions for a packing policy, while the proof augments remaining reservoir units hypothetically rather than requiring a forced-empty finite-horizon design.
The published article studies immediate online treatment assignment, partitions covariate space into pigeonholes, and balances treatment counts within cells to control matching discrepancy.

Theorem 1 gives an O(log^2 n)-competitive algorithm for non-bipartite online min-cost matching on the line with general arrivals in the unknown-iid model; its waiting pool is not subject to a deterministic capacity constraint.
